description: This file implements the VaultNetflix class, providing methods for managing cryptographic keys, including loading, exporting, importing, deleting, and retrieving key information, as well as obtaining ESN and specific named keys. It interacts with external cryptographic libraries and system info components.

classes.name: VaultNetflix
classes.description: A class managing cryptographic keys and ESN for Netflix integration, including key loading, exporting, importing, deletion, and retrieval.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::NetflixInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a singleton instance of VaultNetflix, initializing it with environment-based key loading.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::loadBoundKeys
methods.description: Loads bound keys from input data and initializes ESN and named keys.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::esn
methods.description: Retrieves the ESN string, caching it after first retrieval.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::namedKeys
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the map of named keys (DKE, DKH, DKW).

methods.name: VaultNetflix::GetNamedKey
methods.description: Fetches a named key handle from the external library and stores it in internal maps.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::AddKey
methods.description: Adds a key handle to internal map and returns its assigned ID.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::GetNewKeyHandle
methods.description: Finds the next available key handle ID.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::deleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a key by handle from external library and internal map.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::FindKey
methods.description: Finds a key handle in internal map by ID.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::FindNamedKey
methods.description: Finds a named key ID in internal map by name.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::DeleteKeyFromMap
methods.description: Removes a key handle from internal map.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::getKeyInfo
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about a key, such as type, algorithm, and usage.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::Size
methods.description: Returns size of a key, exporting if public and DH algorithm, or USHRT_MAX if sealed.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::Import
methods.description: Stores a public key for DH operations, returning an ID.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::Export
methods.description: Exports a public key by ID.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::Put
methods.description: Stores a sealed key blob and returns its ID.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::Get
methods.description: Retrieves a sealed key blob by ID.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::Delete
methods.description: Deletes a key by ID, except for the encryption key.
